about_summary: Loanzy.uk is an unbuilt UK domain in the personal finance space, positioned to provide clear, unbiased educational content and informational tools about personal loans for UK consumers. The site will help people understand loan types, terminology, costs, and how to make smarter borrowing decisions — without acting as a broker, lender, or regulated introducer. A same-named platform exists in India (loanzy.asia) and a lead-aggregation entity at loanzytech.com, but neither represents this UK domain, which is a blank slate.
target_audience: UK adults aged 25–55 who are considering a personal loan for the first time or returning to the market after a gap — including people consolidating debts, funding home improvements, or covering a large one-off cost — who want to understand their options before approaching any lender
unique_selling_points: No applications, no referrals — purely informational, so readers trust the content is in their interest
UK-specific focus: all content references FCA rules, UK lenders by type (not by name for endorsement), and UK consumer rights
Interactive cost calculator that shows true total repayment cost, not just monthly figures
Plain English across all content — no jargon without immediate explanation
Structured learning path from 'what is a personal loan' to 'how to compare and decide'
